{
  "claims": [
    {
      "subject": "The name of this organization",
      "predicate": "shall be",
      "predicate_hint": "organization name",
      "object": "The Meridian Society of Ashgrove Polytechnic Institute",
      "quote": "The name of this organization shall be The Meridian\nSociety of Ashgrove Polytechnic Institute, hereinafter the Society.",
      "anchor": "[p.2 ¶2]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "The purpose of the Society",
      "predicate": "is",
      "predicate_hint": "organization purpose",
      "object": "to convene the Lantern Lecture Series, to conduct an annual Spring Appeal in support of that series, and to maintain an equipment lending library for the use of the Society and of other recognized student organizations",
      "quote": "The purpose of the Society is to convene the Lantern\nLecture Series, to conduct an annual Spring Appeal in support of\nthat series, and to maintain an equipment lending library for the\nuse of the Society and of other recognized student organizations.",
      "anchor": "[p.2 ¶3]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "Membership",
      "predicate": "is open to",
      "predicate_hint": "membership eligibility",
      "object": "any enrolled student of the Institute upon payment of dues for the current semester",
      "quote": "Membership is open to any enrolled student of the\nInstitute upon payment of dues for the current semester.",
      "anchor": "[p.2 ¶5]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "Only members in good standing",
      "predicate": "may vote",
      "predicate_hint": "voting rights",
      "object": "vote",
      "quote": "Only members in good standing\nmay vote.",
      "anchor": "[p.2 ¶6]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "The officers of the Society",
      "predicate": "shall be",
      "predicate_hint": "officer positions",
      "object": "a President, a Vice President, a Treasurer, a Secretary, and an Archivist",
      "quote": "The officers of the Society shall be a President, a\nVice President, a Treasurer, a Secretary, and an Archivist.",
      "anchor": "[p.3 ¶2]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "The President",
      "predicate": "shall be a signatory on",
      "predicate_hint": "signing authority",
      "object": "every account of the Society",
      "quote": "The President shall preside at all meetings and shall\nbe a signatory on every account of the Society.",
      "anchor": "[p.3 ¶3]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "The Treasurer",
      "predicate": "shall be a signatory on",
      "predicate_hint": "signing authority",
      "object": "every account of the Society",
      "quote": "The Treasurer shall keep the accounts of the Society,\nshall report the balance of every account at each regular meeting,\nand shall be a signatory on every account of the Society.",
      "anchor": "[p.3 ¶4]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "The Assistant Treasurer",
      "predicate": "shall not be a signatory on",
      "predicate_hint": "signing authority",
      "object": "any account",
      "quote": "The Assistant\nTreasurer shall hold no independent authority to disburse funds of\nthe Society and shall not be a signatory on any account.",
      "anchor": "[p.3 ¶5]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "Officers",
      "predicate": "shall take office on",
      "predicate_hint": "officer term",
      "object": "the first day of July following, serving until the thirtieth day of June next after",
      "quote": "Officers shall be elected at the last regular meeting\nof the spring term and shall take office on the first day of July\nfollowing, serving until the thirtieth day of June next after.",
      "anchor": "[p.4 ¶2]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "No officer",
      "predicate": "shall serve more than",
      "predicate_hint": "term limit",
      "object": "two consecutive terms in the same office",
      "quote": "No officer shall serve more than two consecutive terms\nin the same office.",
      "anchor": "[p.4 ¶3]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "Regular meetings",
      "predicate": "shall be held not less than",
      "predicate_hint": "meeting frequency",
      "object": "once each month of the academic term",
      "quote": "Regular meetings shall be held not less than once each\nmonth of the academic term.",
      "anchor": "[p.4 ¶5]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "One third of the members in good standing",
      "predicate": "shall constitute",
      "predicate_hint": "quorum requirement",
      "object": "a quorum for the transaction of business",
      "quote": "One third of the members in good standing shall\nconstitute a quorum for the transaction of business.",
      "anchor": "[p.4 ¶6]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "The President",
      "predicate": "may appoint",
      "predicate_hint": "committee appointment",
      "object": "such committees as the business of the Society requires",
      "quote": "The President may appoint such committees as the\nbusiness of the Society requires.",
      "anchor": "[p.4 ¶8]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "No committee",
      "predicate": "shall incur an obligation on behalf of the Society without",
      "predicate_hint": "committee authority",
      "object": "the prior approval of the membership",
      "quote": "No committee shall incur an\nobligation on behalf of the Society without the prior approval of\nthe membership.",
      "anchor": "[p.4 ¶8]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "Dues",
      "predicate": "shall be fixed by",
      "predicate_hint": "dues setting",
      "object": "a two-thirds vote of the members in good standing at the first regular meeting of the fall term",
      "quote": "Dues shall be fixed by a two-thirds vote of the members\nin good standing at the first regular meeting of the fall term,\nand shall not be altered during the year then in progress.",
      "anchor": "[p.5 ¶2]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "The Society",
      "predicate": "shall maintain",
      "predicate_hint": "bank accounts",
      "object": "an operating account and a restricted Spring Appeal Fund",
      "quote": "The Society shall maintain an operating account and a\nrestricted Spring Appeal Fund.",
      "anchor": "[p.5 ¶3]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "No disbursement in excess of two hundred fifty dollars ($250)",
      "predicate": "shall issue without",
      "predicate_hint": "disbursement authority",
      "object": "the signatures of both the President and the Treasurer",
      "quote": "No disbursement in excess of two hundred fifty dollars\n($250) shall issue without the signatures of both the President\nand the Treasurer.",
      "anchor": "[p.5 ¶4]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "A disbursement of two hundred fifty dollars or less",
      "predicate": "may issue on",
      "predicate_hint": "disbursement authority",
      "object": "the signature of the Treasurer alone",
      "quote": "A disbursement of two hundred fifty dollars or\nless may issue on the signature of the Treasurer alone.",
      "anchor": "[p.5 ¶4]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "The books of the Society",
      "predicate": "shall be presented for review by",
      "predicate_hint": "financial review",
      "object": "the outgoing Treasurer to the incoming Treasurer before the first day of July in each year",
      "quote": "The books of the Society shall be presented for review\nby the outgoing Treasurer to the incoming Treasurer before the\nfirst day of July in each year.",
      "anchor": "[p.5 ¶5]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    },
    {
      "subject": "This Constitution",
      "predicate": "may be amended by",
      "predicate_hint": "constitutional amendment",
      "object": "a two-thirds vote of the members in good standing at a regular meeting, provided that the text of the proposed amendment has been circulated in writing not less than fourteen days before that meeting",
      "quote": "This Constitution may be amended by a two-thirds vote\nof the members in good standing at a regular meeting, provided\nthat the text of the proposed amendment has been circulated in\nwriting not less than fourteen days before that meeting.",
      "anchor": "[p.6 ¶2]",
      "valid_from": null,
      "valid_until": null
    }
  ]
}
